messages:
nora: Kickoff: I want a short, ship-ready "priority handshake" for private deploys (VPC + on-prem). Goal: settle launch gates and who touches what. Keep scope tiny.

ben: Suggest "operator golden path" concept: one documented upgrade path we guarantee (IP stickiness + peering handoff). Everything else is tech-preview.

alejandra: Field input: customers ask for a tiny artifact bundle they can hand to netops: 1) peering manifest (minimal fields), 2) signed airgap tarball, 3) one-page runbook.

sam: Engineering constraints: to promise IP stickiness we need a `verify-ip-preserve` post-upgrade job and operator hooks for staged rollout (control-plane first). We'll provide a kubectl job and an operator flag `--upgrade-safe`.

ravi: Security: require signed manifests (sig + checksum), BYO-KMS examples, and least-priv IAM snippets. Also include a short note on credential exchange: use a temporary peering token (not raw console keys).

nora: Proposed launch gates (minimal):
- Signed installer + airgap tarball published and checksum-verified
- Peering manifest + temporary peering-token flow documented
- `verify-ip-preserve` script + smoke test published
- One-page netops-runbook + email template ready
- Audit-log routing basics + BYO-KMS recipe
If any gate fails we label as "field-enabled GA" only.

ben: Owners: installer/artifacts: @devon; ip test + script: @sam; runbook/email: @alejandra; security templates: @ravi.

ops-bot: Created ticket RDW-PL-8201 "Priority handshake: private deploy minimal gates"  Assignees: @devon @sam @alejandra @ravi. ETA 9bd.

alejandra: I'll draft the runbook and a short maintenance-window checklist that fits in an email.

sam: I'll prototype `verify-ip-preserve` and drop an example output block for the runbook.

ravi: I'll prepare KMS + peering-token examples and a short creds-exchange checklist.

nora: Good. Let's freeze wording for the one-pager by Thu and aim for an internal demo next Mon. Ping #eng-runtime if you hit infra blockers. :thumbsup:
